item: OSM trends: tag adoption and openings and closures per country, in the World map tab (v0.6.0 B3a, S06-01 S3)
key_paths: src/osm/trends.py; src/api/osm_lane.py; src/static/app-map.js; src/static/index.html; src/static/locales/*.json; tests/test_osm_trends.py; tests/test_osm_trends_ui.py; tests/osm_trends_node_test.js
summary: New local route GET /api/osm/countries/{code}/trends and an "OpenStreetMap trends" panel under the completeness view. Per country, from the tag rows the daily change files wrote: tag adoption (opening_hours, website, email, phone: places that gained or lost the key, per day, the contact:* twin merged, an empty value counted as absent) and openings and closures (places that appeared, disappeared or stopped qualifying, and the signals disused:* added, shop changed to vacant, opening_hours changed to closed or off). Counts distinct places per day; a day with no change file is absent rather than zero; a stretch the lane was cut again (mirror retention or by hand) is stated as not observed. The planet's past (osm_history_changes, by month) is a separate block, shown only if the full-history read finished, and never added to the window. Method on hover, caveat visible, the full table of every day beside each chart. Reads the local lane only; no network. 30 new strings in 12 locales (non-English AI-drafted, to join the native-review list of OPEN_QUEUE (33)).
